title: Halogenated N-phenylpiperazine and 2-(piperazin-1-yl)pyrimidine as novel cucurbit[7]uril guests: experimental and computational insights into supramolecular binding
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45555-45572
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07259J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
David A. Rincón, Ewelina Zaorska, Maura Malinska
This study presents a new class of halogenated N-phenylpiperazine and 2-(piperazin-1-yl)pyrimidine derivatives as guests for cucurbit[7]uril (CB[7]), expanding the space of CB[7]-binding ligands.
